file:
workflow:
  name: cel-label-group
  resources:
    default:
      cpu: 1
      memory: 512Mi
      storage: 1Gi
      platform: <audit-platform>
  groups:
  - name: pair
    tasks:
    - name: leader
      image: ubuntu:24.04
      command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      args:
      - echo attribution-start; sleep 300; echo attribution-complete
      lead: true
    - name: worker
      image: ubuntu:24.04
      command:
      - /bin/sh
      - -c
      args:
      - echo attribution-start; sleep 300; echo attribution-complete
